daily_amal_info_how_body:
• Complete each amal by tapping the checkbox
• Filter by category
• Add your own custom amal
• Resets automatically at midnight every day
• All amal completed means 100% complete
daily_amal_info_miswak_hadith1_text: Miswak cleanses the mouth and earns the pleasure of Allah.
daily_amal_info_miswak_hadith2_text: If it were not a hardship on my Ummah, I would have commanded them to use miswak at every prayer.
daily_amal_info_surah_hadith1_text: Whoever recites Surah Ikhlas, it is as if he has recited one-third of the Quran.
daily_amal_info_surah_hadith2_text: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
daily_amal_info_surah_hadith3_text: Surah Mulk will intercede for its reciter against the punishment of the grave until he is forgiven.
daily_amal_info_dua_hadith2_text: Whoever recites Sayyid al-Istighfar three times in the morning and evening, and dies on that day or night, will enter Paradise.
daily_amal_info_dua_hadith3_text: Whoever says three times in the morning and evening: "Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil ardi wa la fis sama'i wa huwas sami'ul alim" — nothing will harm him.
daily_amal_info_nafl_hadith1_text: The night prayer (Tahajjud) is the best prayer after the obligatory prayers.
daily_amal_info_nafl_hadith2_text: Praying two rak'ahs of Duha (Chasht) is equivalent to giving charity for each of the 360 joints in the body.
daily_amal_adhkar_main_title:
Morning & Evening
Dua and Dhikr of Rasulullah (ﷺ)
daily_amal_adhkar_note: Note: Bengali transliteration is provided, but reading from Bengali pronunciation is discouraged.
prayer_info_how_body:
• The day is counted only when the fard prayer is offered
• Each prayer has 2 fard options:
  1) In congregation / at the beginning of time — on time
  2) Late — offered later within the time
• Selecting any one fard option marks that prayer as complete
• When all 5 fard prayers are done, the day's prayers are 100% complete
prayer_info_early_title: Virtues of praying at the beginning of time
prayer_info_hadith1_text: The reward of prayer offered in congregation is twenty-seven times greater than that of prayer offered alone.
prayer_info_hadith2_text: Whoever offers the Isha prayer in congregation, it is as if he has spent half the night in prayer. And whoever offers both Isha and Fajr in congregation, it is as if he has spent the entire night in prayer.
prayer_info_hadith3_text: Whoever prays in congregation for forty days, catching the first takbir, will have two freedoms written for him: freedom from Hellfire and freedom from hypocrisy.
prayer_info_hadith4_text: For every step a person takes to attend the congregational prayer, his rank is raised, sins are erased and good deeds are written.
prayer_info_hadith5_text: The most burdensome prayers for the hypocrites are Fajr and Isha. If they knew what (reward) lies in them, they would come even if they had to crawl.
prayer_info_hadith6_text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: Which deed is best? He said: Prayer at its earliest time.
prayer_info_hadith7_text: The beginning of the prayer time is the pleasure of Allah, and the end of the time is the forgiveness of Allah.
prayer_info_hadith8_text: The two rak'ahs of Fajr Sunnah are better than this world and everything in it.
prayer_info_hadith9_text: Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs of Sunnah prayers in a day and night, a house will be built for him in Paradise.
prayer_forbidden_msg: Prayer is not allowed at this time
reading_info_how_body:
• Add sessions under each category
• Enter minutes and pages/ayah/hadith count
• Set your daily goal from Settings
• When the goal is reached, it will show as completed
• The tracker resets automatically every midnight
reading_info_hadith1_text: For every letter of the Quran that a person recites, he will have one good deed, and each good deed is multiplied by ten.
reading_info_hadith2_text: The one who recites the Quran and has memorized it will be with the noble righteous scribes (angels). And the one who recites it, striving hard because it is difficult for him, will have two rewards.
reading_info_hadith3_text: Recite the Quran, for it will come as an intercessor for its companions on the Day of Resurrection.
reading_info_hadith4_text: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
reading_info_hadith5_text: Whoever sets out on a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make the path to Paradise easy for him.
reading_info_hadith6_text: May Allah brighten (the face of) the person who hears my statement, learns it, preserves it, and conveys it to others.
reading_info_hadith7_text: Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim man and woman.
reading_info_hadith8_text: Whoever goes out seeking knowledge is in the path of Allah until he returns.
reading_info_hadith9_text: The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets. The Prophets did not leave behind dinar or dirham, but they left behind knowledge.
sin_kaffara_done_all: Alhamdulillah! You have completed kaffara for all sins.
sin_kaffara_pending: {count} sins still need kaffara. Repent sincerely.
dhikr_morning_11_title: Morning & evening dhikr #11 – Allahumma 'afini fi badani
dhikr_morning_11_pron: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari. La ilaha illa Anta. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-kufri wal-faqr, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa Anta.
dhikr_morning_11_meaning: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no true god except You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave; there is no true god except You.
dhikr_morning_11_fazilat: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to regularly recite this dua.
dhikr_morning_12_title: Morning & evening dhikr #12 – Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah
dhikr_morning_12_pron:
Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nar wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.

(In the evening say: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah ... Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylah ... wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylah ...)
dhikr_morning_12_meaning:
We have entered the morning and the whole dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no true god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. O our Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good that comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that comes after it. O my Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the hardships of old age. O my Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

(In the evening, say: We have entered the evening ... and the meaning is adjusted for evening.)
dhikr_morning_12_fazilat: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this regularly in the morning and evening.
dhikr_morning_13_title: Morning & evening dhikr #13 – Subhanallahi wa bihamdih
dhikr_morning_13_meaning: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him.
dhikr_morning_13_fazilat: Whoever says this 100 times in the morning and evening will come on the Day of Judgment with no one having done better than him in reward, except someone who said the same or more. In another narration, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
dhikr_morning_14_pron: Allahumma fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, la ilaha illa anta rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah. A'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkihi, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
dhikr_morning_14_meaning: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is no true god except You, Lord and Sovereign of all things. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Shaytan and his traps, and from committing wrong against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
dhikr_morning_14_fazilat: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught this dua to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (RA) and instructed him to recite it every morning and evening.
dhikr_morning_15_title: Morning & evening dhikr #15 — Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
dhikr_morning_15_pron: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
dhikr_morning_15_meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all! By Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
dhikr_morning_15_fazilat: The Prophet (ﷺ) instructed Fatimah (RA) to recite this every morning and evening.
dhikr_morning_16_title: Morning & evening dhikr #16 — Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin
dhikr_morning_16_pron:
Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, fa lakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.

(Note: In the evening, say 'amsa' instead of 'asbaha')
dhikr_morning_16_meaning:
O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation has risen upon this morning is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and all gratitude.

(In the evening: ... entered upon this evening...)
dhikr_morning_16_fazilat: Saying this in the morning fulfills the gratitude to Allah for the entire day, and saying it in the evening fulfills the gratitude for the night.
dhikr_morning_17_pron: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa ridha nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi.
dhikr_morning_17_meaning: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him, to the number of His creation, to the extent of His pleasure, to the weight of His Throne, and to the extent of His words.
dhikr_morning_17_fazilat: Saying this once after Fajr is more rewarding than sitting in dhikr for a long time. So alongside other adhkar, reciting this will earn double the reward, in sha Allah.
dhikr_morning_18_title: Morning & evening dhikr #18 — Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an
dhikr_morning_18_pron: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
dhikr_morning_18_meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
dhikr_morning_18_fazilat: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say this after the Fajr prayer.
dhikr_morning_19_title: Morning & evening dhikr #19 — Asbahna 'ala fitratil Islam
dhikr_morning_19_pron:
Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifam-muslima. Wa ma kana minal-mushrikin.

(Note: In the evening, say 'amsayna' instead of 'asbahna')
dhikr_morning_19_meaning:
We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the word of sincerity (tawhid), upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim — upright and Muslim. And he was not among the polytheists.

(In the evening: We have entered the evening...)
dhikr_morning_19_fazilat: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite this regularly.
dhikr_morning_20_title: Morning & evening dhikr #20 — Radhitu billahi rabba
dhikr_morning_20_pron: Radhitu billahi rabba, wa bil-islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyya.
dhikr_morning_20_meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet.
dhikr_morning_20_fazilat: Whoever says this 3 times in the morning and evening, it becomes Allah's right to make him pleased on the Day of Judgment.
dhikr_morning_21_title: Morning & evening dhikr #21 — Allahumma bika asbahna
dhikr_morning_21_pron:
Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.

(In the evening: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.)
dhikr_morning_21_meaning:
O Allah, by Your grace we have entered the morning and by Your grace we enter the evening. By Your grace we live and by Your will we die, and to You is the resurrection.

(In the evening: O Allah, by Your grace we have entered the evening and by Your grace we enter the morning. By Your grace we live and by Your will we die, and to You is the return.)
dhikr_morning_21_fazilat: The Prophet (ﷺ) encouraged reciting this dua.
dhikr_morning_22_title: Morning & evening dhikr #22 — Tasbih (Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar)
dhikr_morning_22_meaning:
(1) Glory be to Allah.
(2) All praise is for Allah.
(3) Allah is the Greatest.
dhikr_morning_22_fazilat:
Subhanallah: Better than giving 100 camels in the way of Allah.
Alhamdulillah: Better than giving 100 horses with riders for jihad.
Allahu Akbar: Better than freeing 100 slaves.
dhikr_morning_22_count:
After Fajr
Before Maghrib
100 times each
dhikr_morning_1_pron: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum. La ta'khudhhu sinatuw-wala nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuhituna bi-shay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma, wa huwal 'aliyyul 'adhim.
dhikr_morning_1_meaning: Allah — there is no true god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them. And they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
dhikr_morning_1_fazilat: Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi in the morning and evening will be protected from jinn throughout the day and night. If recited before sleeping, Shaytan will not come near.
dhikr_morning_2_title: Morning & evening dhikr #2 — 3 Quls (Ikhlas, Falaq, Nas)
dhikr_morning_2_pron:
(1) Qul huwallaahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.

(2) Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffaathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.

(3) Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
dhikr_morning_2_meaning:
(1) Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. And there is none comparable to Him.

(2) Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.

(3) Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.
dhikr_morning_2_fazilat: Sufficient to protect the reciter from all kinds of harm.
dhikr_morning_3_title: Morning & evening dhikr #3 — Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa
dhikr_morning_3_pron: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul 'arshil 'adhim.
dhikr_morning_3_meaning: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no true god except Him. I have placed my trust in Him, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
dhikr_morning_3_fazilat: Whoever says this dua 7 times in the morning and 7 times in the evening, Allah will suffice him against all worries and anxieties of this world and the Hereafter.
dhikr_morning_4_pron: Allahumma anta rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani, wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu. A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi. Faghfir li fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
dhikr_morning_4_meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no true god except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I am upon Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sins. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
dhikr_morning_4_fazilat: Whoever recites this with firm conviction in the morning and evening, and dies on that day or night, will be among the people of Paradise.
dhikr_morning_5_title: Morning & evening dhikr #5 — Bismillahilladhi la yadurru
dhikr_morning_5_pron: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim.
dhikr_morning_5_meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm. And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
dhikr_morning_5_fazilat: Whoever says this dua 3 times each morning and evening, nothing will harm him.
dhikr_morning_6_title: Morning & evening dhikr #6 — La ilaha illallahu... (Tahlil)
dhikr_morning_6_pron: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
dhikr_morning_6_meaning: There is no true god except Allah alone, without any partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.
dhikr_morning_6_fazilat: Saying it 10 times morning and evening earns 10 good deeds, erases 10 sins, raises 10 ranks, and is equivalent to freeing 4 slaves, with protection from Shaytan. Saying it 100 times in the morning equals freeing 10 slaves, earns 100 good deeds, erases 100 sins, and gives protection from Shaytan until evening.
dhikr_morning_7_title: Morning & evening dhikr #7 — Allahumma ajirni minan-nar
dhikr_morning_7_meaning: O Allah, protect me from the Hellfire.
dhikr_morning_7_fazilat: Whoever says this 7 times after Fajr and Maghrib before speaking to anyone, and dies on that day or night, Allah will protect him from the Hellfire.
dhikr_morning_8_title: Morning & evening dhikr #8 — Allahumma inni as'alukal 'afwa
dhikr_morning_8_pron: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya, wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfadhni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini, wa 'an shimali, wa min fawqi. Wa a'udhu bi-'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti.
dhikr_morning_8_meaning: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me. And I seek refuge in Your greatness from being swallowed up from beneath me.
dhikr_morning_8_fazilat: The most comprehensive dua for total protection. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never missed this dua in the morning and evening.
dhikr_morning_9_title: Morning & evening dhikr #9 — Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka
dhikr_morning_9_pron:
Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika wa mala'ikataka wa jami'a khalqika, bi-annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika laka wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk.

(Note: In the evening, say 'Allahumma inni amsaytu' instead of 'Allahumma inni asbahtu')
dhikr_morning_9_meaning:
O Allah, I have entered the morning, and I call You to witness, and the bearers of Your Throne, and Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah — there is no true god except You alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

(In the evening: O Allah, I have entered the evening...)
dhikr_morning_9_fazilat: Whoever says this 4 times in the morning or evening, Allah will free him from the Hellfire.
dhikr_morning_10_title: Morning & evening dhikr #10 — A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammat
dhikr_morning_10_pron: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
dhikr_morning_10_meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
dhikr_morning_10_fazilat: Whoever says this 3 times in the evening, no venomous creature will harm him that night.
dhikr_info_how_body:
• Tap on each dhikr card to increase the count
• When the target is reached, it will be marked as completed
• There are 6 default adhkar with a fixed target of 100 (cannot be changed)
• You can add custom adhkar and change their target counts
• Tap the orange number to quickly adjust the count
• The tracker resets automatically every midnight
dhikr_info_hadith1_text: Whoever says Subhanallah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 33 times after every prayer, his sins will be forgiven even if they are as much as the foam of the sea.
dhikr_info_hadith2_text: There are two phrases that are light on the tongue but heavy on the scale: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi and La ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar.
dhikr_info_hadith3_text: Subhanallahi wal hamdulillah fill the scale, or fill what is between the heavens and the earth.
dhikr_info_hadith4_text: Whoever says Subhanallah one hundred times in a day, one thousand good deeds will be written for him and one hundred sins erased.
dhikr_info_hadith5_text: Whoever regularly seeks forgiveness (makes istighfar), Allah will grant him relief from every worry, a way out of every hardship, and provide for him from where he does not expect.
dhikr_info_hadith6_text: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.
dhikr_info_hadith7_text: The best dhikr is: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulk wa lahul hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir.
dhikr_info_hadith8_text: Whoever says La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah... one hundred times in a day, it is as if he freed ten slaves, one hundred good deeds are written for him, one hundred sins erased, and he is protected from Shaytan until evening.
dhikr_info_hadith9_text: Whoever sends salah upon me once, Allah will send mercy upon him ten times.
dhikr_info_hadith10_text: The closest of people to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those who sent the most salah upon me.

reminder_set_guide_common_title: Check these first on any Android phone
reminder_set_guide_a_desc:
Settings → Apps → {appName} → Notifications
• Allow notifications = ON
• Lock screen / Pop-up / Banner / Sound = ON
reminder_set_guide_b_desc:
Settings → Apps → {appName} → Battery
• Select Unrestricted / Don't optimize
reminder_set_guide_c_desc:
Settings → Apps → {appName} → Mobile data & Wi-Fi
• Background data = ON
• Unrestricted data usage = ON
reminder_set_guide_e_desc: Keep Do Not Disturb / Focus mode OFF or add this app as an exception
reminder_set_guide_f_desc:
Settings → Special app access → Alarms & reminders
• Allow
reminder_set_guide_xiaomi_autostart_desc:
Settings → Apps → Permissions → Autostart / Background autostart
• {appName} = ON
reminder_set_guide_xiaomi_battery_desc:
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → {appName} → Battery
• No restrictions / Unrestricted
• Allow background activity = ON
reminder_set_guide_xiaomi_recents_desc: Open Recent apps → Long press {appName} → Tap Lock icon
reminder_set_guide_xiaomi_security_desc:
Security app → Battery → App battery saver
• No restrictions
• Exclude {appName} from "Clear cache/Boost speed"
reminder_set_guide_samsung_sleeping_desc:
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits

usage_intro: This app is designed to help you track your daily ibadah. You get accurate prayer times based on your location, a smart reminder system, and detailed amal tracking.
usage_reminder_types_1: Default reminder: active automatically at 7 times
usage_reminder_types_2: Personal reminder: set your own times
usage_reminder_types_4: Repeat: daily, specific days, or once
usage_reminder_default_dhikr_3: Daily amal: every day at 10:00 PM
usage_reminder_personal_2: Daily amal, morning/evening dhikr, prayer times
usage_reminder_personal_3: Change times as per your convenience
usage_reminder_custom_2: Enter reminder name, time and description
usage_reminder_custom_3: Select specific days of the week
usage_reminder_custom_4: Set with offset from prayer times
usage_reminder_trouble_1: Turn OFF "Background restriction" in phone battery settings
usage_reminder_trouble_3: Exclude app from Do Not Disturb mode
usage_reminder_trouble_5: Whitelist app in Power saving mode
usage_prayer_calc_1: Calculation Method: University of Islamic Sciences, Karachi
usage_prayer_calc_3: Coordinates: based on your GPS location (2 decimal places)
usage_prayer_location_2: If location is off, shows Dhaka time
usage_prayer_location_3: Same time on all devices in same area
usage_prayer_location_4: Timezone: based on your device timezone
usage_prayer_location_5: Location permission needed for accurate times
usage_prayer_waqt_1: Fajr: from Subh Sadiq (18° below sun) until sunrise
usage_prayer_waqt_5: Isha: when red glow (shafaq) disappears (17° angle)
usage_prayer_makruh_4: No nafl prayer during these times
usage_prayer_special_3: Tahajjud: from after Isha until Fajr
usage_prayer_special_4: Nafl: any time except makruh times
usage_prayer_tracking_1: Mark each of the five prayers separately
usage_prayer_tracking_4: See current prayer and remaining time
usage_dhikr_tracking_2: Digital tasbih - button tap or direct number entry
usage_dhikr_tracking_4: Session history and daily goal tracking
usage_reading_types_4: Separate goal and progress bar for each
usage_sin_purpose_1: Identify weaknesses and help with tawbah
usage_sin_purpose_3: Fully private - only on your device
usage_sin_purpose_4: See improvement or decrease in statistics
usage_stats_viz_1: Weekly bar chart and monthly line chart
usage_stats_viz_3: Progress rate, streak and overall score
usage_stats_viz_4: Prayer, amal, dhikr, reading - separate tabs
usage_cloud_sync_1: Auto sync: every change goes to cloud
usage_cloud_sync_4: Multi-device: same data on all devices with same account
usage_settings_main_1: Prayer Time Adjustment: +/- minutes for local time
usage_settings_main_4: Theme: Dark mode with gold accent (#D4AF37)
usage_trouble_common_1: Prayer times not updating → Check GPS and Internet
usage_trouble_common_2: Cloud sync not working → Verify email and re-login
usage_trouble_common_4: Statistics empty → Complete activity and refresh
usage_trouble_common_5: App crash → Clear cache or reinstall
usage_trouble_tips_1: Keep Location permission on only when needed
usage_trouble_tips_3: Check statistics regularly to stay motivated
usage_contact_intro: For issues, bug reports, or feature suggestions, email us:
usage_contact_tips: Tip: You get faster help if you describe the issue with a screenshot.
usage_contact_tech_ref: Technical Reference: Prayer time calculation follows University of Islamic Sciences, Karachi method. Asr time is per Hanafi madhab. Accurate times are obtained via AlAdhan API using GPS coordinates.
stats_qaza_instruction: After offering a qaza prayer, mark it as done. Once marked, it won't show again.
stats_qaza_all_done: All qaza prayers have been completed
stats_streak_threshold: You need at least 60%+ progress for a day to count toward streaks
home_location_enable_body:
Turn on your phone's location service to get accurate prayer times.

If location is off, reminders will use Dhaka time.
home_sin_all_kaffara: Alhamdulillah! You have completed kaffara for all sins.
home_sin_pending: {count} sins still need kaffara. Repent sincerely.
home_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
preset_tahajjud_desc: Wake up in the last third of the night
reminder_defaults_info: These reminders are always on and are automatically set based on prayer times.
